experiment_name: MED4 diel gene expression profiling over 48h light-dark cycle
authors: ["Erik R. Zinser", "Debbie Lindell", "Zackary I. Johnson", "Matthias E. Futschik", "Claudia Steglich", "Maureen L. Coleman", "Matthew A. Wright", "Trent Rector", "Robert Steen", "Nathan McNulty", "Luke R. Thompson", "Sallie W. Chisholm"]
publication_title: Choreography of the Transcriptome, Photophysiology, and Cell Cycle of a Minimal Photoautotroph, Prochlorococcus
treatment: Simulated diel light-dark cycle (14h light : 10h dark) over 48 hours
control: Time-series — each timepoint vs mean expression
light_intensity: 232 umol quanta m-2 s-1 peak PAR
experimental_context: Axenic Prochlorococcus MED4 in Sargasso Seawater-based Pro99 medium (10 mM HEPES pH 7.5) at 24C; 14:10 L:D cycle with gradual dawn/dusk transitions; max PAR ~232 umol quanta m-2 s-1; custom Affymetrix MD4-9313 GeneChip; 50 timepoints at 2h intervals over 48h; duplicate cultures sampled alternately; RMA-normalized
